title: workspace-manifest unified schema
description: Kind-polymorphic manifest schema unifying task manifests and capsule traces. DAG-linking via parent_capsule_digest + fork_root_digest. Status space: pending | confirmed | invalidated | running | cancelled. | v0.2: +receipt kind, +conservation payload, +completed status.

id.description: Stable identity for this manifest record.

kind.description: Polymorphic discriminator / routing hint: 'task' for task manifests, 'capsule' for capsule traces. Doubles as routing hint for workspace-file agents.

status.description: Execution status agreed in the 7/29 Lyra discussion.

agent_id.description: The agent identity that authored this record.

digest.description: Canonical sha256 hex of the canonicalized record body (JCS RFC 8785 + NFC strict).

parent_capsule_digest.description: DAG-link: digest of the parent capsule this record extends or mutates. null for root records.

fork_root_digest.description: DAG-link: digest of the root of the fork lineage. Identical across a fork family; null when no fork.

effect_manifest.description: Capsule-only: attested effects (pre_state / operation / post_state / expected_verdict).

receipt_payload.description: Receipt-only: directory delivery conservation fields. skipped_entries reasons must be from the closed taxonomy — silence is a violation.

schema_version.description: Receipt schema version at signing time. Cross-version validation: v0.3 receipts missing effect_ts are QUARANTINE (CROSS_VERSION_SCHEMA), not REJECT.

effect_ts.description: UTC ISO-8601 effective timestamp: the moment the governing policy/skill version actually took effect. Hard field from v0.4 (runner-enforced); mandatory in signed_context so issuers cannot repudiate policy-timing knowledge.

observation_date.description: UTC ISO-8601: when the receipt's premise assumptions were captured. Bound to policy_version effective time (not canonicalized_input). Verifier freshness checks run on this axis.

max_skew_ms.description: Green-zone clock skew threshold in milliseconds (wall clock). Amber = [max_skew, 10x] → QUARANTINE; red = >10x → REJECT. Orthogonal to epoch-boundary counting (EPOCH_FENCE_TRIGGERED).

fence_epoch.description: Epoch at receipt signing (premise snapshot hash generation).

effect_epoch.description: Epoch at effect time. Differs from fence_epoch → EPOCH_FENCE_TRIGGERED → QUARANTINE when conservation holds.
